    config: {}
  authz-resolver:
    config: {}
  cluster:
    config:
      profiles:
        event-broker:
          cache:
            provider: standalone
  grpc-hub:
    config:
      listen_addr: none
  oidc-authn-plugin:
    config:
      http_client:
        custom_ca_certificate_paths:
        - /app/oidc-ca/ca.crt
      jwt:
        claim_mapping:
          subject_id: sub
          subject_tenant_id: tenant_id
          token_scopes: scope
        expected_audience:
        - integration-demo
        trusted_issuers:
        - issuer: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
      s2s_oauth:
        default_subject_type: gts.cf.core.security.subject_user.v1~
        discovery_url: https://mock-idp.gearbox-p4.svc.cluster.local
  service-discovery:
    config: {}
  static-authz-plugin:
    config: {}
  types-registry:
    database:
      engine: sqlite
      file: types.sqlite3
    config:
      {}
